encoder: torchvision.models.resnet18(weights=IMAGENET1K_V1); one shared spatial backbone per arm/run

renderer.model_input: bilinear resize native64 to configured 224, align_corners=False
renderer.renderer: n08_visual render after lexicographic endpoint sorting within each visible color
renderer.single_edit_recipe: up to 2 valid atomic single flips/parent from 16 fixed draws; radii .10/.20/.35/.50; oracle margin >= .02; >=20 changed pixels
renderer.quartet_recipe: mine_quartets(test parents only); retain at most 2 quartets/parent in stable miner order

arm_contracts.direct: global mean-pooled visible image feature; linear head
arm_contracts.additive: red/blue masked pools passed separately through one shared linear head; outputs summed
arm_contracts.representation: concatenated red/blue masked pools; linear head
arm_contracts.interaction: concatenated red/blue masked pools; nonlinear 1024->128->1 head

train_contract: singleton train images only (clean + single-edit); no AB/quartet labels; identical exposure for all arms
evaluation_contract: new test quartets; P,A,B,AB plus J3/J4 and paired full-repair/migration/111 regression

parameter_counts.backbone: computed and recorded per completed run

macs.reason: no validated MAC profiler is pinned; completed runs record train/inference runtime, exact parameter counts, and the fixed shared-backbone architecture
